name: Sorana Cîrstea
intro: Sorana Cîrstea is a tennis veteran from Romania. She has played on tour for 20 years. At 36, she is playing the best tennis of her life!
story: Her mom put a racket in her hand at age four. She reached the French Open quarterfinals way back in 2009. This year she did it again, 17 years later! This is her last season on tour, so cheer extra loud! On Friday she beat the 19th seed, a top-ranked player, in straight sets.

funFacts.text: Her favorite ice cream flavor is coconut. Sweet!
She speaks Romanian, English, and Spanish. Now she is learning French.
She loves reading books and doing crossword puzzles on the road.
New York is one of her two favorite cities in the world.
She has a younger brother named Mihnea.
Her tennis hero is Steffi Graf. Seeing Steffi on TV made her want to play.
In February she won a title at home in Romania without losing a set.

watchFor: Watch her big forehand, her favorite shot, crack winners from way back.
